patient.asrText: It started about six weeks ago during a particularly busy period at work. I was sitting at my desk for long hours, but there wasn't any specific injury or incident that triggered it. It developed gradually. At first, it was just a mild discomfort, but I started noticing it more frequently over time. It's become more noticeable over the last few weeks. Initially, I only felt it occasionally, but now I experience it almost every day. Not really. I've had occasional back stiffness after sitting for long periods. But I've never experienced this kind of persistent pain before. Yes, I saw my GP about two weeks ago, because the pain wasn't improving. They prescribed ibuprofen and advised me to keep moving and avoid prolonged bed rest. I haven't had any scans or other investigations. No. I don't have any major medical conditions. No previous major injuries or surgeries. I've occasionally experienced some neck stiffness, but nothing that required medical treatment. Just ibuprofen when the pain gets worse. I'm not taking any other regular medication.
